text.text_excerpt: This is such a cool hangout for beer lovers. Not only can you get delicious beer that is super fresh, but you can get NOLA brews that are only available in the tap room. It's a great excuse to spend an evening "taste testing" some of the best beers around. The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable, and although the tap room itself it small, there are plenty of seats at picnic style tables. When I stopped in on Friday I tried the Pineapple Habanero IPA, which is a beer with a little spice to it (and a tap room exclusive) and I also had the Prytania Porter, which was dark and delicious. The beers are constantly rotating, so I will definitely be back to see what they are going to brew next.

Had a great time at their Friday 2-3pm Happy Hour. It's an odd time for sure, but it's more of a free tasting than a happy hour. Friday's 2-3 you can go and get a sample of one beer for free. You walk in and you get a coin for a free beer and a stamp on your hand. Then you go back to their brew room and can choose from about 6 beers for your free one. It's truly a regular sized free beer, which was appreciated! I stayed for a few hours with friends and got a few other beers to try - loved them all! The Beer is amazing. The BBQ is so amazing that I had to take a FB Live video while eating it!!! I think I got lucky here. Arrived on Friday, and they were handstamping you so you can have a free BEER! Did I say Free? Yes. Free BEER! 1 order. Isn't that a welcoming place! THERE was a scheduled tour that afternoon and boy did my trip to NOLA started off right!! After a 4hr flight and having only chips and pretzles on the plane, the BBQ here definitely hit the spot! My friend and I ordered the BBQ poutine (only 16 bucks for a large order). We did half pork and beef. Basically it on a bed of waffle fries, cheese curds, beef, and pork.
